cite.locator: Boxed warning: Risk of Serious Cardiovascular and Gastrointestinal Events
cite.quote: NSAIDs cause an increased risk of serious gastrointestinal (GI) adverse events, including bleeding, ulceration, and perforation of the stomach or intestines, which can be fatal.
NSAIDs have produced elevations in plasma lithium levels and reductions in renal lithium clearance.
cite.note: Mesma tabela: "During concomitant use of diclofenac sodium delayed-release tablets and lithium, monitor patients for signs of lithium toxicity."

review.notes: A bula citada é do comprimido oral de diclofenaco sódico de liberação retardada. anvisa_principles inclui outros sais e formas do mesmo fármaco, inclusive tópicas (diclofenaco dietilamônio), das quais esta bula não trata.
